description_en: Initiates a conversation with a chatbot by using the unique chatbot identifier (chatbot ID)
description_zh: 根据机器人唯一标识（机器人Id）与其进行会话
name: BeeBotChat

parameters.help_en: The session ID, which identifies the session and context information of a visitor
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID, 用于标识一个访问者的会话和上下文信息
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The input from the chatbot visitor
parameters.name: utterance

parameters.help_en: The ISV verification code, which is used to verify whether a RAM user is authorized by the ISV
parameters.help_zh: Isv校验码，用于校验子账号是否由ISV授权
parameters.name: isv_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge title in the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_id

parameters.help_en: The intent name in the dialog flow. If you specify this name, the chatbot directly enters this intent for Q&A
parameters.help_zh: 对话流中意图名称，若指定此名称，机器人会直接进入此意图做问答
parameters.name: intent_name

parameters.help_en: The visitor ID, which identifies the user in the current session
parameters.help_zh: 访问者ID。用于识别当前会话中的用户
parameters.name: sender_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the visitor in the current session
parameters.help_zh: 当前会话中访问的昵称
parameters.name: sender_nick

parameters.help_en: The custom parameter set. This is a JSON-formatted set of user-defined parameters that can be passed to various dialog engines
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数集，一个JSON格式的用户自定义参数集，可以传入用户自定义的参数到各对话引擎
parameters.name: vendor_param

parameters.help_en: The SpaceId of the ISV sub-customer
parameters.name: cust_space_id
